test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Nisha buys a mobile phone for her child. The phone is marked at ₹24,500 and is offered with two successive discounts of 20% and C%, respectively. After receiving both discounts, she pays ₹13,132. Find the value of C.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive discount formula: Final Price = MP × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂)

13132 = 24500 × 0.8 × (1 − C/100)

13132 = 19600 × (1 − C/100)

(1 − C/100) = 13132 ÷ 19600 = 0.67

**∴ C = 33%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price = 24500, Discounts = 20% and C%, Final Price = 13132

**Formula used:**

Final Price = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ After first discount: Price = 24500 × 80/100 = 19600

⇒ After second discount: 19600 × (100 − C)/100 = 13132

⇒ 19600 × (100 − C) = 1313200

⇒ 100 − C = 1313200 ÷ 19600 = 67

⇒ C = 33

**∴ The correct answer is 33%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

Net price = MP × (1 − a/100) × (1 − b/100)

Equivalent Discount

Equivalent discount = a + b − (a × b)/100

Quick Ratio Method

Convert discounts into multipliers like 80%, 70% and multiply directly.
